papers.title_en: EARS-Info: Information-Aware Event-Driven Reallocation for Multi-Robot Exploration
papers.authors: Kabeh Mohsenzadegan, Vahid Tavakkoli, Kyandoghere Kyamakya
papers.evidence: 多机器人探索重分配与协调
papers.tldr: 多机器人探索需要在地图网格上高效分配目标，但通信丢包和能量约束会让重分配变得困难。作者提出EARS-Info，在事件驱动蚁群重分配搜索EARS基础上加入边际感知增益、可行重定位、返程感知路由、感知预留与最短路径缓存。在8个城市地图、168000个回合的对比中，该方法在每个评测面板均取得最高平均运行得分；8机器人、3%丢包下较EARS-Safe提升5.43%，加权发现率由88.88%升至98.46%，能耗降2.62%。该工作表明信息感知的完整控制器能稳定提升探索效率与安全性，但各组件的独立贡献仍待厘清。
papers.abstract_en: We introduce EARS-Info, an information-aware extension of Event-Driven Ant Reallocation Search for multi-robot exploration on OpenStreetMap-derived grids. It combines marginal sensing gain, feasible relocation, return-aware routing, sensing reservations, and cached shortest paths. Across 168,000 episodes comparing 30 implementations on eight city maps, EARS-Info achieves the highest mean operational score in every evaluation panel. With eight robots and 3% communication dropout, it improves the score over EARS-Safe by 5.43%, increases weighted discovery from 88.88% to 98.46%, and reduces mean energy use by 2.62%. Score differences are positive in all eight cities ($p=0.0078125$; descriptive 95% city-bootstrap interval $[0.0159,0.0694]$), with no simulated incidents across 5,600 EARS-Info episodes. These results support the complete controller; individual component advantages remain uncertain. Generalization is limited by reused geography, one training replicate, coarse maps, and adapted comparison methods.

papers.title_en: Minimum Sufficient Communication for Independent Behaviour Tree Robot Teams
papers.evidence: 协调机器人团队的通信策略
papers.tldr: 机器人团队运行独立行为树且黑板私有时，如何用最少通信维持协作成功尚缺量化框架。作者在声明策略族内扫描消息内容与准入频率，以每次决策接收者加权比特数衡量流量，并用单侧同时置信界与全状态通信对比。八种内容策略在四类仓库条件下测试：低争用下零通信为精确最小值；缩放条件下q=0.992222的不释放策略确认充分，成功率达96.33%，仅占全状态流量0.544%。该框架可报告精确最小值、正区间、充分上界或未决边界，为最小充分通信评估提供统计化流程。
papers.abstract_en: We present an experimental framework for determining sufficient communication in robot teams running fixed, independent Behaviour Trees with private blackboards. Within a declared policy family, we vary message content and admission frequency and measure traffic in recipient-weighted bits per robot decision. A dense sweep identifies candidate policies for comparison with full-state communication. We retest selected candidates and the reference on fresh, paired scenarios, using one-sided simultaneous confidence bounds to assess whether success remains within five percentage points of the full-state reference. The bounds also assess whether tested cheaper policies can be ruled out as insufficient. Depending on the evidence, the framework reports an exact minimum, a positive bracket, a sufficient upper bound, or an unresolved boundary. Experiments with eight content policies across four warehouse conditions identify zero communication as the exact minimum under low contention. In the scaled condition, the no-release policy at gate $q=0.992222$ is confirmed sufficient, achieving 96.33% success at an estimated rate of 738.55 bits per robot decision, or 0.544% of full-state traffic. The positive minimum remains unresolved. These claims apply only to the declared policy family, sampled gate values and operating conditions.

papers.title_en: AI-Driven Digital Twin Framework for Warehouse Logistics Automation Optimization
papers.authors: Md Mahinur Alam, Kanita Jerin Tanha, Md Tanjin Alam, Shadman Sakib, Min Gyu Kim
papers.evidence: 仓储物流自动化与货位优化
papers.tldr: 仓库物流优化正从静态货位策略转向能适应实时状态的数据驱动动态方法。本文提出将强化学习智能体嵌入基于FlexSim的数字孪生环境，并借助资产管理壳（AAS）实现学习体、物理资产与孪生体交互。实验显示平均拣选时间降29.66%、吞吐量升35.42%、行走距离降18.54%。该框架验证了实时在线学习用于仓储货位优化的有效性。
papers.abstract_en: In recent years, warehouse logistics optimization has increasingly focused on intelligent, data-driven systems to enhance operational efficiency. Conventional static product placement strategies are being progressively replaced by dynamic slotting approaches that can adapt to real-time variations in warehouse conditions. In this work, we present a novel framework that employs a reinforcement learning agent integrated within a FlexSim-based Digital Twin environment for real-time product placement optimization. The proposed agent continuously learns from streaming operational data, enabling it to reduce picking time while improving overall system throughput. The simulation environment models a four-zone warehouse layout with forklift-based material handling and leverages the Asset Administration Shell framework to ensure seamless interaction between the learning agent, physical asset, and the digital twin. Experimental evaluation demonstrates substantial performance gains, with the proposed approach achieving a 29.66\% reduction in average picking time, a 35.42\% increase in throughput, and an 18.54\% decrease in travel distance.

papers.title_en: Tunable Spatial Task Allocation with Application to Maritime Swarms
papers.authors: Vishnudatta Thota, Tyler Paine, Anastasia Bizyaeva
papers.evidence: 机器人团队在空间任务间的多智能体任务分配
papers.tldr: 面向海上自适应测绘等场景，多自主智能体需在空间任务间灵活重分配。本文推广非线性意见动力学，并将意见更新与空间运动直接耦合，形成可调的空间任务分配规则。仿真显示社会耦合强度可调节群体凝聚力，产生从最大分散、半分散到共识聚集的可解释宏观模式。方法在动态任务与通信约束下支持实时重构，且接近匈牙利最优。
papers.abstract_en: In this chapter, we explore how a team of autonomous agents can flexibly reconfigure the distribution of its members across many spatially embedded tasks using a task allocation strategy grounded in a generalization of the recently proposed Nonlinear Opinion Dynamics model. Motivated by an adaptive maritime survey application, we couple opinion dynamics directly to spatial movement and examine how the emergent macroscopic allocation is shaped by the interplay between environmental geometry, nature of social interactions, and task demands. We illustrate in simulation how social coupling in the model tunes group cohesion, producing macroscopic allocation patterns ranging from maximally dispersed states, to intermediate semi-dispersed states with a smaller number of distinct subgroups, to maximally cohesive consensus states, in distinct and interpretable parameter regimes. Furthermore, we demonstrate with illustrative examples how a team can reconfigure itself in real time under changing task demands. For allocation scenarios with distance-based task preference and matched number of agents and tasks, we relate numerically the final allocation in the group to the Hungarian optimum, illustrating close-to-optimal performance. We illustrate performance of this method under realistic communication constraints in the MOOS-IvP-Multi simulation environment with simulated autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs). Together, these examples show how a common set of local interaction rules can support a large range of interpretable macroscopic allocation states and flexible transitions between them.

papers.title_en: Information-Driven Collaborative Autonomy for Heterogeneous UAV/UGV Teams
papers.evidence: 异构无人机与地面车团队协同
papers.tldr: 面向未知数量潜在危险目标的异构无人机/地面车协同搜索问题，论文提出信息驱动的闭环自主框架。无人机用遍历控制按信息密度规划航迹，并结合动态视场检测模型与贝叶斯PMB后验引导搜索；地面车采用机会约束避障和空洞概率路径规划。各编队以SCvx*–C-ADMM完全分布式求解并随信息更新轨迹，仿真验证了去中心化与集中式性能及多机闭环协作。
papers.abstract_en: This paper considers coordinating a heterogeneous team of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) and unmanned ground vehicles (UGVs) traversing a domain containing an unknown number of potentially hazardous targets. The UAVs provide aerial sensing using onboard optical cameras, adapting their trajectories to ground routes and target information. We formulate the aerial search problem using ergodic control, which distributes sensing effort according to a spatial information density to balance exploration and target localization. The formulation incorporates dynamic camera field-of-view footprints and pose-dependent probabilistic detection models. Angles-only measurements are processed through Bayesian inference and marginalization over data-association hypotheses to obtain a Poisson multi-Bernoulli (PMB) approximation of the target posterior, representing both detected and undetected targets. This belief directs aerial sensing toward unexplored regions along the ground routes and viewpoints that improve target localization. Ground planning combines chance-constrained target avoidance, enforced through confidence sets, with a void-probability objective that favors routes unlikely to contain threats. We solve each team's optimization problem in a fully decentralized manner using a nested SCvx*--C-ADMM scheme, with outer sequential convex programming iterations and inner distributed consensus optimization, accounting for nonlinearities, nonseparable objectives, and continuous-time inter-agent separation constraints. A closed-loop scheme updates both fleets' trajectories as information becomes available and permits ground motion when the remaining route risk falls below a prescribed threshold. Numerical case studies examine sensing geometry and target uncertainty, compare decentralized and centralized solvers, and demonstrate full closed-loop collaboration between multiple UAVs and UGVs.

papers.title_en: WorldMirror: Agentic Real-to-Sim Generation of Interactive Worlds from In-the-Wild Robot Demonstrations
papers.authors: Tianling Xu, Weijie Wan, Honghao Su, Kailun Su, Junyuan Tang, Huichi Zhou, Haozheng Zhang, Qi Xiong, Ping Luo, Wenbo Ding, Tianxing Chen, Yue Chen
papers.evidence: 面向机器人环境表征的智能体真实到仿真世界生成
papers.tldr: 机器人仿真训练通常需要手工搭建场景与指定任务，难以规模化；而野外机器人演示天然提供多样且真实的交互观测。WorldMirror 把 real-to-sim 构建建模为对可执行世界程序的迭代精化：编码智能体分解观测场景、规划重建步骤，并调度图像与 3D 生成工具，再依据验证反馈修正程序。相机位姿锚定的场景表示将世界组织为静态视觉背景、支撑几何与可编辑交互资产。在 DROID 上的实验显示，该方法能重建视觉逼真、几何一致的交互世界，并保持录制轨迹的物理有效性，为利用真实演示规模化生成仿真数据提供新路径。
papers.abstract_en: Existing approaches for robot learning in simulation often require substantial manual effort to construct scenes and specify tasks, limiting training scalability and data diversity. Meanwhile, in-the-wild robot demonstrations naturally provide diverse and realistic observations of real-world interactions. Leveraging these demonstrations for simulation requires both high-fidelity visual reconstruction and physically consistent interactions. General-purpose agents offer flexible adaptation to diverse scenarios and strong reasoning about 3D spatial relationships, while specialized generative models provide high-fidelity reconstruction of scene appearance and geometry. We introduce WorldMirror, an agentic real-to-sim framework that constructs interactive digital twins from in-the-wild robot demonstrations. Our central idea is to formulate real-to-sim construction as the iterative refinement of an executable world program. A coding agent decomposes the observed scene, plans reconstruction steps, and orchestrates specialized image and 3D generation tools, refining the program through verification feedback. A camera-pose-anchored scene representation organizes the world into static visual context, support geometry, and editable interactive assets while preserving spatial relationships among the scene, objects, and robot. The agent uses this representation to diagnose and correct reconstruction errors, enabling physically consistent interaction and trajectory replay. Experiments on DROID demonstrate that WorldMirror can reconstruct visually faithful and geometrically consistent interactive worlds while preserving the physical validity of recorded robot trajectories.

papers.title_en: Continuous-Action World Models: Learning Cross-Embodiment Spatiotemporal Dynamics Priors
papers.evidence: 学习时空动力学先验以支持机器人动作生成的世界模型
papers.tldr: 机器人动作生成难以跨具身和不同执行频率迁移，且异构轨迹缺乏统一的时空动力学表示。论文提出连续动作世界模型CoAWM，先通过函数预训练将不同具身和采样频率的轨迹映射到共享潜在函数空间，学习动作重建与时间采样一致性先验；再将函数空间接入世界模型骨干，以观测、语言指令和当前状态为条件预测潜在动作函数，并由单解码器在任意查询时刻输出末端执行器动作。摘要未报告量化实验，但该框架将共享先验与任务条件选择、时间采样解耦，为跨具身、跨控制频率迁移机器人经验提供统一基础。
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Continuous-Action World Models (CoAWM), a framework for learning cross-embodiment spatiotemporal dynamics priors that support robot action generation across embodiments and execution frequencies. At its core is a shared latent function space that captures the spatial and temporal structure of robot actions. We learn this space through two stages. First, function pretraining brings trajectories from different embodiments and sampling frequencies into a common representation, learning shared dynamics priors through action reconstruction and consistency across temporal sampling views. By accommodating heterogeneous robot trajectories, this stage broadens the range of data sources available for pretraining and facilitates scaling to larger and more diverse datasets. Second, we connect the pretrained function space to a world-model backbone, enabling observations, language instructions, and the current robot state to condition the prediction of a latent action function. A single decoder takes any query time and returns the corresponding end-effector action. By separating shared dynamics priors from task-conditioned action selection and temporal sampling, our approach provides a unified foundation for transferring robot experience across embodiments and control frequencies.

papers.title_en: Adaptive search with path-constrained mobile sensors using multi-arm bandits
papers.authors: Abraham P. Vinod, Parth K. Thaker, Gautam Dasarathy, Stefano Di Cairano
papers.evidence: 移动传感器团队的路径选择与协调
papers.tldr: 针对能量受限移动传感器在可行路径集合内搜索兴趣区域的问题，论文将带路径约束的主动路径选择建模为多臂老虎机，并利用置信界自适应分配路径。作者还提出基于图的低基数路径覆盖构造方法，以降低候选路径规模。理论分析给出有限时间与任意时刻正确性保证及检测和标记时间的非渐近上界，并在广泛实例上匹配下界。仿真验证了路径冗余与团队规模对搜索性能的影响。
papers.abstract_en: We study a constrained sequential decision problem for detecting regions of interest from noisy online measurements collected by a team of energy-constrained mobile sensors. The sensor motion is restricted to a precomputed set of feasible paths that satisfy mobility constraints, limited available energy by requiring return to charging stations, and avoidance of known obstacles. We cast the resulting active path selection as a multi-armed bandit problem and propose an iterative search algorithm that adaptively assigns paths using confidence bounds computed from the collected data. We also propose a graph-based method to construct low-cardinality path covers under the team's constraints. We establish finite-time and anytime probabilistic correctness guarantees for the proposed algorithm, derive non-asymptotic upper bounds on the times required to detect all regions of interest and to label all nodes, and show that these bounds match algorithm-independent lower bounds up to constant factors for a broad class of problem instances. Using numerical simulations, we illustrate the behavior of the proposed approach and the effect of path redundancy and team size on search performance.
